multi_agent_support.coordination_protocol: agents coordinate via JSONL messages and worktree isolation

zero_tolerance_rules: NEVER run git init without searching for existing repos FIRST
NEVER ask for credentials - check vault and FileZilla sitemanager.xml first
NEVER use markdown formatting in user messages (no **bold**, ## headers, - bullets)
NEVER use em-dashes in generated content (AI tell)
ALWAYS base PRs on develop, NEVER main
ALWAYS use worktree for feature work, NEVER edit base repo in feature mode
ALWAYS release worktree IMMEDIATELY after PR creation
NEVER auto-assign ClickUp tasks - people pick up tasks themselves
ALL generated files → E:\jengo\documents\ (NEVER C:\scripts, C:\Temp, repo roots)
NEVER include literal email/phone/address in public content - PII security rule
NEVER add unverifiable facts to content - one lie destroys ALL credibility
BEFORE bulk generation (10+ images, 1000+ lines) - calculate cost, get approval if >EUR 1
